source_basis.finding: The same epoch checkpoint dictionary is saved separately to last.pt and, on weak-BCE improvement, best.pt; retained epoch files copy last.pt. Serialized archive bytes can differ without a learned-parameter difference.

same_selected_epoch.rule: Reuse the existing BCE-selected best.pt and its exact final run.selected checkpoint SHA for both candidate policies.
same_selected_epoch.candidate_identity: The same training epoch under both policies is one model, even if separately serialized retained-epoch bytes have a different SHA.

different_selected_epoch.rule: Bind the alternative epoch to the immutable retained checkpoint index SHA, actual epoch artifact SHA and original history metrics after fixed12 completion.
